label: Lab 14
title: Can an AI jury judge how a room looks?
question: Can a jury of AI models, scoring pictures blind, tell how good a room looks, and how much does its score move when nothing changed?
how: Two blind rounds with the same scoring sheet. A test pair, one good picture and one ruined, takes a juror off the jury when it cannot tell them apart. Rooms that were not reworked show how much the scores wobble on their own. Numbers only, no pictures.
status: Judged by AI models, not people
